paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.93% on average, with DAX strongest (+0.23%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.46%). Brent crude changed +2.89% to 111.97. Gold changed -2.31% to 4,054.3. Bitcoin changed -0.82% to 80,410.6016. The US 10-year yield stands at 5.02%, a relative move of -2.45%. Among the firms tracked, Evercore (+15.98%) and Santander (-11.81%) moved the most.
